newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Motor up on yen, new engine.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Motor up on yen, new engine.

text.p: Shares of Mitsubishi Motors Corp were higher in Thursday morning trade, supported by the yen's weakness and a new engine which Mitsubishi Motors has developed and introduced in Japan, traders said.
The share price was up 10 yen at 961 yen at the end of the morning session. Volume was 1.29 million shares, and the issue was the 10th mostly heavily traded.

The engine, called a direct injection gasoline engine, can match the fuel economy of the diesel engine while retaining the traditional gasoline engine's superior performance, Mitsubishi Motors said earlier this month.
